summary: Controls the game's trespassing warning. It hides only the warning, so the game's AI still reacts. A client resource can hide the same element by itself with Hud.setHudPart('Trespassing').

enabled.summary: Whether the warning shows. True by default.

setEnabled.summary: Shows or hides the warning for all players.
setEnabled.example:
// A roleplay server where every house is open.
kcds.world.RestrictedAreaMarker.setEnabled(false);
setEnabled.exampleLua:
-- A roleplay server where every house is open.
kcds.world.RestrictedAreaMarker.setEnabled(false)
setEnabled.exampleCs:
// A roleplay server where every house is open.
RestrictedAreaMarker.SetEnabled(false);
